purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for one ordinary BioDrone Standard line-kit mismatch at Pallas Yard Twelve.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the line-issue alcove, corporate liturgy, Rain-Again's physical identity, cross-body tracing, route-clock pressure, and six low-stakes aftermath states.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use distinct visual_scene_id anchors for the establishing alcove, issue liturgy, wrong-coupler reveal, each materially different tracing action, the route-clock fold, and each ending family. The silent-coupler realization receives an object closeup before the second choice layer.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt is a complete visible frame for a general image model. It describes the alcove geometry, materials, light, bodies, support equipment, objects, and positions needed for that beat. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: humane retro-industrial science-fiction storybook illustration, precise ink linework under restrained translucent gouache, graphite and blue-gray habitat metal, amber work lamps, cold blue inventory light, worn tactile materials, dry workplace comedy held inside bleak corporate order, readable silhouettes and interfaces, cinematic interactive-fiction framing; interface graphics use simple color blocks, serial bars, and abstract inventory glyphs.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every rendered prompt from the global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Each base prompt already carries enough identity and geometry to stand alone. Keep visual_continuity_notes out of assembled prompt text.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: All beats occupy one compact issue alcove from six camera slots, and counter occlusion, object custody, character reach, and the camera blind strip affect branch meaning. The embedded scene_set is sufficient for draft staging but not a rendered geometry source.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout from the fixed zones, routes, occluders, camera slots, staging slots, and state anchors specified below.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a compact industrial line-issue alcove off Service Ring Kappa inside a rotating manufactured Bloom habitat at Pallas Yard Twelve. A muster-corridor door enters from frame left; a sliding route hatch to the curved service ring exits frame right beneath an amber four-minute clock. A bolted waist-high counter divides the scuffed worker lane from caged supplier lockers filled with gray limiter couplers, audit seals, belt recorders, and diagnostic adapters. A small secondary return board sits under the worker-side counter lip, carrying blue and yellow tactile chips, grease slashes, and short string knots. Overhead amber work lamps meet cold blue inventory lights; ribbed shell supports, dark TCS substrate, consolidated asteroid aggregate behind service panels, pipe trunks, cable trays, and worn yellow floor lines make the habitat visibly engineered. Nara-7, a slender pale gray-brown engineered humanoid seal technician in a numbered gray skinsuit, waits at the yellow line. Eli Venn, a compact dark-skinned human issue clerk in a green-gray counter jacket, stands behind the counter. Orrin Dax, a broad older human rigger in a patched brown-orange jacket, waits with an old anchor hook. Teth Inkwise, a mottled blue-gray uplifted cephalopod in an open mobile dry-operation harness with oxygenation tubes and support loops, rests beside the harness rack.

behind the counter between slate and supplier cages
